title: PCA-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Perception-Cognition-Action Chain

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing single-metric multiple-choice accuracy (Action Score) against a proposed composite metric (Genuine PCA Score) to identify fluky correct answers that result from a model's systematic preference for specific choice indices.

Using a fine-grained, anchor-based evaluation protocol (PCA-Eval) that scores outputs against specific ground-truth criteria (perception, cognition, and action) to prevent the systematic bias of LLM evaluators favoring longer responses.
